subject: PHYSICS
description: ICSE 10th Physics: Refraction, Lenses, Spectrum, Echoes, Ohm's law, and Household Circuits

questions.question: What is the minimum distance required from an obstacle to hear a distinct echo in air (at 20°C)?
questions.explanation: Since persistence of hearing is 0.1 s and speed of sound is ~344 m/s: d = (344 × 0.1)/2 = 17.2 m.

questions.question: Which color of white light deviates the most when passing through a triangular glass prism?
questions.explanation: Violet has the shortest wavelength and lowest speed in glass, so it suffers maximum deviation.

questions.question: What happens to the resistance of a metallic wire when its length is doubled and cross-section halved?
questions.explanation: R = ρ(L/A). If L is doubled and A is halved: R' = ρ(2L / (A/2)) = 4R.

questions.question: In a household electrical wiring system, the fuse is always connected in which wire?
questions.explanation: The fuse is placed in the Live wire to cut off high voltage from the appliance during a fault.

questions.question: When a ray of light passes from an optically denser to rarer medium at critical angle, angle of refraction is:
questions.explanation: By definition, the critical angle corresponds to an angle of refraction of 90° in the rarer medium.
